research.name: shadcn.io
research.note: Independent shadcn/ui block, template and component library for React, Vue, Svelte and Solid with an MCP server for agents.
unverified: The GitHub org shadcnio has react-shadcn-components, which holds only a README of links to shadcn.io, and a 0-star ui repo that appears to be a shadcn/ui copy; openSource false is based on not finding the library's own source there.
The pricing page lists animated buttons, text effects and WebGPU shaders, but those were not opened and seen running.
